Thanks for applying to the Platform Product PM role — I’m Ben on the recruiting team at Redwood Inference. I’d love to set up a short 20-minute intro to learn a bit about your background and share more about the role and team.

Can you do one of these 20-minute windows (times listed in your local timezone if you include it below)?
